post.summary: Validate a brief, caption or image
post.description: Briefs and captions are checked against the active policy and the study facts. Without the model check (VALIDATION_MODEL_MODE=off) the run finishes before this returns (state SUCCEEDED; semantic rules stay UNABLE_TO_ASSESS). With it, this queues a job (state QUEUED): poll GET /validations/{validation_run_id} until SUCCEEDED (or FAILED). A finished PASS or FAIL with identical content, configuration and versions is reused (state SUCCEEDED). job_id equals validation_run_id. Images need DEMO_STUBS (501 otherwise); poll those until SUCCEEDED. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the original run. Each brief or caption run also stores the policy context it was checked against (see GET /validations/{validation_run_id}/context). If that context can't be gathered in time, the run is stored as NEEDS_REVIEW (or FAIL), never PASS, with a coverage gap.
